entry.author: Our Coromandel
entry.summary:
Feeling unsure about how to submit your application for the Claymark Hauraki Coromandel Business Awards? Don’t worry - it’s easier than you think! 😊
We’ve put together a simple how-to video guide to walk you through the process, so you can feel confident hitting “submit.” ✅
👉 Check out the video below and get started today!
And remember, if you have any questions along the way, we’re here to help. 
You’ve got this - we can’t wait to see your application! 🌟
See more at https://www.tcdc.govt.nz/HCBA
